ctaHeading: Ready for Your Sunshine Joinery Project?
aboutText: Apex Joinery has been serving the Sunshine community for over 25 years, specializing in custom cabinetry and timber joinery. Our team crafts high-quality kitchen cabinets, wardrobes, and built-in solutions tailored to your home. We pride ourselves on reliability and craftsmanship, delivering projects on time and to the highest standards. Whether it's a new build or a renovation, we're here to help Sunshine residents create functional and beautiful spaces.
servicesText: From custom cabinetry to complete kitchen fitouts, Apex Joinery offers a comprehensive range of services. We handle both domestic and commercial projects, ensuring precision and durability in every piece we create. Our team works closely with clients to bring their visions to life.

services.title: Custom Cabinetry
services.desc: Bespoke cabinets designed and built to fit your space perfectly, using quality materials and finishes.

services.title: Kitchen Installations
services.desc: Complete kitchen renovations and new installations, from design to final touches, tailored to your style.

services.title: Wardrobe Systems
services.desc: Custom wardrobes and storage solutions that maximize space and organization in your home.

services.title: Timber Shelving
services.desc: Sturdy and stylish shelving units for living rooms, offices, and retail spaces in Sunshine.

services.title: Commercial Fitouts
services.desc: Professional joinery for shops, offices, and restaurants, enhancing functionality and aesthetics.

services.title: Repairs & Restoration
services.desc: Expert repair and restoration of existing joinery, bringing new life to old furniture and fixtures.
